title: Mapping spaces in an iterated coherent slice
statement:
Use quasicategories, coherent slices, mapping spaces and homotopy fibers of spaces from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Fix a containing universe and a locally small quasicategory $\mathcal E$. Let $f:A\to B$, $q:X\to A$ and $p:Y\to A$ be arrows, and choose coherent composites $fq$ and $fp$. In $\mathcal E_{/B}$ put $a=(A,f)$, $x=(X,fq)$, $y=(Y,fp)$ and regard the chosen composition triangles as arrows $\widetilde q:x\to a$ and $\widetilde p:y\to a$. There are equivalences of full mapping spaces
$$\operatorname{Map}_{(\mathcal E_{/B})_{/a}}(\widetilde q,\widetilde p)\simeq\operatorname{hofib}_{\widetilde q}\bigl(\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal E_{/B}}(x,y)\xrightarrow{\widetilde p\circ-}\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal E_{/B}}(x,a)\bigr)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal E_{/A}}((X,q),(Y,p)).$$
The latter comparison forgets the redundant compatibility over $B$, retaining the underlying arrow $X\to Y$ and its specified homotopy over $A$. It is coherently natural in $(X,q)$ and $(Y,p)$, compatible with changes of the chosen composites, and with all simplicial parameters. No limits or colimits in $\mathcal E$ are assumed.
